quote: A generic 900-coefficient sum of sinusoids also fails to beat the null
problem: Paper Table IV gives control C1 as 0.258 / +0.28 on zeros 401--500 (null 0.263) and 0.267 / +0.22 on 801--1000 (null 0.274). Both rms values are slightly below the null, and the correlation interval [+0.08, +0.46] excludes zero. The paper's wording is "stays within 0.005 of the null" and "gains almost nothing over the null", not that it fails to beat it. By the chapter's own criterion (rms below null and positive correlation), C1 marginally beats the null.
fix: A generic 900-coefficient sum of sinusoids also stays near the null (0.258 against 0.263, a gain of almost nothing)
